Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that starts a streaming recognizer with language and punctuation settings using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 2 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 3 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 4 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Option 5 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 6 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speechsdk
import os
import time

class SpeechRecognizer:
    def __init__(self, subscription_key, region):
        self.speech_config = speechsdk.SpeechConfig(subscription=subscription_key, region=region)
        self.speech_config.speech_recognition_language = "en-US"
        # Enable detailed recognition results, including punctuation
        self.speech_config.set_property(
            speechsdk.PropertyId.SpeechServiceResponse_OutputFormat, "Detailed"
        )
        self.speech_config.set_property(
            speechsdk.PropertyId.SpeechServiceResponse_PostProcessingOption, "TrueText"
        )

        self.audio_config = speechsdk.audio.AudioConfig(use_default_microphone=True)
        self.speech_recognizer = speechsdk.SpeechRecognizer(
            speech_config=self.speech_config, audio_config=self.audio_config
        )

        self.all_results = []
        self.stopping = False

        # Connect callbacks
        self.speech_recognizer.recognized.connect(self.recognized_cb)
        self.speech_recognizer.recognizing.connect(self.recognizing_cb)
        self.speech_recognizer.session_started.connect(lambda evt: print(f"SESSION STARTED: {evt}"))
        self.speech_recognizer.session_stopped.connect(self.session_stopped_cb)
        self.speech_recognizer.canceled.connect(self.canceled_cb)

    def recognizing_cb(self, evt):
        print(f"RECOGNIZING: Text={evt.result.text}")

    def recognized_cb(self, evt):
        if evt.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.RecognizedSpeech:
            print(f"RECOGNIZED: Text={evt.result.text}")
            self.all_results.append(evt.result.text)
        elif evt.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.NoMatch:
            print(f"NO MATCH: Speech could not be recognized.")
        elif evt.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.Canceled:
            print(f"CANCELED: Reason={evt.result.cancellation_details.reason}")
            if evt.result.cancellation_details.reason == speechsdk.CancellationReason.Error:
                print(f"CANCELED: ErrorCode={evt.result.cancellation_details.error_code}")
                print(f"CANCELED: ErrorDetails={evt.result.cancellation_details.error_details}")
                print(f"CANCELED: Did you set the speech resource key and region?")
        
    def session_stopped_cb(self, evt):
        print(f"SESSION STOPPED: {evt}")
        self.stopping = True

    def canceled_cb(self, evt):
        print(f"CANCELED: Reason={evt.reason}")
        if evt.reason == speechsdk.CancellationReason.Error:
            print(f"CANCELED: ErrorCode={evt.error_code}")
            print(f"CANCELED: ErrorDetails={evt.error_details}")
            print(f"CANCELED: Did you set the speech resource key and region?")
        self.stopping = True

    def start_streaming(self):
        print("Starting continuous recognition. Say something and press Ctrl+C to stop...")
        self.speech_recognizer.start_continuous_recognition()
        while not self.stopping:
            time.sleep(1) # Keep the main thread alive

    def stop_streaming(self):
        print("Stopping continuous recognition.")
        self.speech_recognizer.stop_continuous_recognition()
        return " ".join(self.all_results)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Set your Azure Speech Service key and region here
    # It's recommended to set them as environment variables
    # For example:
    # export AZURE_SPEECH_KEY="YOUR_SPEECH_KEY"
    # export AZURE_SPEECH_REGION="YOUR_SPEECH_REGION"
    
    speech_key = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY")
    speech_region = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_REGION")

    if not speech_key or not speech_region:
        print("Please set the AZURE_SPEECH_KEY and AZURE_SPEECH_REGION environment variables.")
        exit(1)

    recognizer = SpeechRecognizer(speech_key, speech_region)
    try:
        recognizer.start_streaming()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        final_text = recognizer.stop_streaming()
        print("\nRecognition stopped.")
        print(f"Final recognized text: {final_text}")
